catalysts.headline: CoreWeave reported Q3 2026 results described as topping estimates; specific revenue/EPS figures not independently located this session
CoreWeave reports Q3 2026 results: revenue $3.66B (+168% YoY, beat ~$3.54B consensus), net loss widens to $709M from $110M a year earlier; raises FY2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B-$13.3B
catalysts.impact: Revenue beat and raised guidance, but widening losses, heavy capex (~$14.5B/quarter vs ~$9B in customer prepayments), ~$47B debt, and customer concentration (top 3 customers = 72% of quarterly revenue) drove a mixed stock reaction

catalysts.headline: CoreWeave Q3 2026 results: revenue $3.661B (+168% YoY from $1.365B), beating the ~$3.54-3.55B analyst estimate; GAAP net loss $709M (vs $110M prior-year quarter) on operating income of $207M; revenue backlog ~$132.5B; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $13.0B-$13.3B (from prior guidance on file); still expects >1.85GW of active power capacity by year-end; total debt reported approaching $47B
catalysts.impact: Shares fell to $47.56 after-hours (-2.4%) despite the beat/guidance raise, as coverage flagged the ~$14.5B quarterly capex against only ~$9B of customer prepayments

conflicts: Stock reaction after Q3 2026 earnings is reported inconsistently: one Stocktwits headline describes shares climbing toward $53 after-hours on an $132.5B backlog, while other MarketBeat/Stocktwits headlines reference a 'guidance cut' and stock 'sliding' — it's unclear from the snippets whether those cautionary headlines refer to the November 2026 report or are stale leftovers from the November 2025 Q3 report (which had different figures: ~$1.36B revenue, 1.36B)

Shares outstanding/market cap: one aggregator implies ~550M shares at a ~$25.57B market cap and $46.43 price; another implies ~550M shares at a ~$58.59B market cap and $107.35 price — the $107.35 price point looks stale/inconsistent with all other November 2026 price data found and should not be used as current
notes: Backlog was reported at $132.5 billion as of Q3 2026. Year-to-date share performance was reported as down ~32% in one source despite the large revenue beat, reflecting investor focus on cash burn/financing risk rather than top-line growth.
